title: Final Energy Values
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and present the final energy values for both thermal and gravitational energy extraction.

title: Efficiency Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the efficiency equation for a perfect engine, including the correct temperature values.

title: Energy from Heat
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the energy extracted from thermal energy using the specific heat and temperature difference.

title: Gravitational Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately compute the gravitational potential energy using the mass, height, and gravitational acceleration.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Comparison Conclusion
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a clear comparison and conclusion regarding the efficiency of both energy extraction methods.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect temperature conversions or sign mistakes in the efficiency calculation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not overlook any necessary factors in the energy equations, such as the specific heat of water.
